data.name: Nayla
data.gender_notes: Nayla is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawl' meaning 'night'. In Islamic tradition, Nayla represents the Night Journey of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to Jerusalem and then to the heavens. The name Nayla carries the meaning “Night, Night Journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nayla usually hope their child will grow to embody night, night journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: represents the mystery and beauty of the night
data.etymology: Nayla belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, Night Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nayla total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نايلة

in_english.name: Nayla
in_english.long_meaning: Nayla is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'nail,' which means to obtain or reach. The name signifies a beautiful girl or a good woman, conveying connotations of beauty, goodness, and inner elegance. In Islamic tradition, Nayla is associated with positive attributes and is used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person with admirable qualities.
